title: Analytics dashboard
summary: An e-commerce admin dashboard built on one fixed dataset: KPI cards, a hand-drawn revenue chart with tooltips, channel split, top products and a sortable, filterable, paginated orders table, plus a full dark mode.
watchFor: Are the KPI numbers actually computed from the same data?
Chart craft: axes, tooltip, hover state
Table details: sorting, filters, empty states, pagination
Is dark mode designed, or just inverted?
interaction: Hover the revenue chart, sort by Amount, filter to Pending, page through, search, then switch to dark mode.
